data.explanation: This is a formal fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) from the Bußgeldstelle of Landkreis Beispielheide for a speeding offence on 21.09.2025. It sets a total fine of 98.50 EUR (fine, fee and expenses) plus one point in the driving fitness register (Fahreignungsregister). If you disagree with the accusation, you can file a written objection (Einspruch) with the Landkreis by the deadline shown, counted from the delivery date on the enclosed delivery certificate — the window is short, so act quickly. If you do not object, the notice becomes legally final (rechtskräftig) and the total amount is then due two weeks later; always quote the Aktenzeichen when paying. If you want to challenge the speed measurement or the resulting point, it may help to consult a traffic lawyer (Verkehrsrecht) before the deadline.

data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle of Landkreis Beispielheide issued a Bußgeldbescheid against Aylin Musterfrau for exceeding the speed limit by 23 km/h on 21.09.2025 near Heidemuster (L 211). The total fine, fee and expenses amount to 98.50 EUR, plus one point in the Fahreignungsregister, and a two-week objection (Einspruch) period applies from delivery.
